instruction.name: VCVTSD2SH
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Convert Low FP64 Value to an FP16 Value

para.string: This instruction converts the low FP64 value in the second source operand to an FP16 value, and stores the result in the low element of the destination operand.
When the conversion is inexact, the value returned is rounded according to the rounding control bits in the MXCSR register.

Bits 127:16 of the destination operand are copied from the corresponding bits of the first source operand. Bits MAXVL-1:128 of the destination operand are zeroed. The low FP16 element of the destination is updated according to the writemask.
